vb_textbox.text: I believe there may be a dominant gnome out of the two colours. there are two pairs of gnomes e.g. red and green and purple and brown. I think the same coloured gnome gave the most mushrooms for a period of time and then it appeared that the dominant gnomes changed (if that theory is correct) so it is a bit of trial and error! I considered 4 or 5 and less to be not a great amount of mushrooms. Good luck!
